novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 (resolution frontier)
novelty_flags.one_line: The advertised strict extension is only against Van Dijcke (2025); Berger et al. is explicitly treated as a different experiment rather than a second estimator/result in a comparator frontier.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 (resolution frontier)
novelty_flags.one_line: The Van Dijcke comparison has only broad prose references to empirical-quantile assumptions, not a theorem/page/equation anchor documenting the oracle-negligibility restriction.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 4 (honest-width frontier)
novelty_flags.one_line: The asserted gap against Van Dijcke, Cai--Hu, and Armstrong--Kolesar lacks a precise result/location anchor for the claimed absence of a complete-experiment width converse.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 / target estimand
soundness_flags.one_line: At fixed m the observed tuple law does not identify the latent LAQTE, as the proposal's own Proposition 3 constructs observationally equivalent laws with different tau; therefore the claim that the observed discontinuity identifies tau must be restricted to direct F observation or reformulated as latent causal interpretation.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 (critical-resolution iff)
soundness_flags.one_line: mcrit is the infimum of a threshold set, but the triangular model imposes no cross-m nesting or monotonicity of rho; the claimed iff for every m does not follow from this definition.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 3 (cusp construction)
soundness_flags.one_line: The construction chooses arbitrary y0 in (0,1) but then declares q0=Fcircle(y0) in Iq without imposing that restriction, so the displayed target index need not exist in the stated domain.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves bounded-sample nonidentifiability of a barycenter quantile and gives the unconditional order-statistic representation for the empirical barycenter.
The manuscript introduces R3D, defines the LAQTE, and reports asymptotic normality and uniform debiased confidence bands for its R3D estimators.
The paper studies sup-norm optimal rates, sparse/dense/intermediate regimes, and a CLT for discretely observed additive-error functional data.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v5, December 2021; published Econometric Theory 40 (2024)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work derives leading empirical-quantile bias and analytical and jackknife corrections for noisy draws.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the observed-identification wording by a direct-latent-observation causal identification proposition, and explicitly define the finite-m object as an inverse-problem target with an identified-set/modulus interpretation.
Define a single nested latent-law class across m, prove or assume a monotone complete-tuple modulus, and state the oracle threshold as membership in the threshold set until monotonicity is proved.
Add a second genuine published comparator or recast the Van Dijcke claim as informed-by; attach exact theorem/page anchors for all flagship comparisons.
Constrain y0 by Fcircle(y0) in [a,b] in the cusp construction and prove the interior choice exists under named class margins.

recommended_next_step: Revise the observed-versus-latent identification claim and the cross-resolution model before advancing; the repaired modulus/frontier kernel remains plausibly field-tier novel.
